questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Limpopo Lillies?
Who holds the record for 'Most Fours' in the 25/26 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Mignon du Preez holds it, with a total of 84.

questions.question: At which ground did Merece Mackier record their career-best innings (47, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2016/10/16.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2021/22 season?
Who holds the record for 'Most Matches Played' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Nonkhululeko Thabethe holds it, with a total of 154.

questions.question: Annelie Minny set a database record (08/09 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 6. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Sixes', held by Annelie Minny.
